Below is a quick‑reference list of the **long‑weekend holidays that occur in Canada during 2023**.  
A “long weekend” is defined as a public holiday that falls on a Friday or a Monday (or is observed on a Monday when it falls on a weekend), giving you a three‑day weekend.  (If you take an extra day off on a Thursday or Tuesday, you can extend the weekend, but that’s not part of the official holiday schedule.)

| Date (2023) | Holiday | Provinces/Regions where it applies | Notes |
|-------------|---------|------------------------------------|-------|
| **Feb 20** | **Family Day** | Alberta, Saskatchewan, Manitoba, Ontario (except Toronto), New Brunswick, Newfoundland & Labrador, Prince Edward Island | Observed on the third Monday in February. |
| **May 22** | **Victoria Day** | All provinces & territories | Observed on the Monday preceding May 25. |
| **Jul 3** | **Canada Day (observed)** | All provinces & territories | Canada Day falls on Saturday, July 1, so the holiday is observed on Monday, July 3. |
| **Aug 7** | **Civic Holiday** | Most provinces & territories (except Quebec, Newfoundland & Labrador, and a few others) | First Monday in August. |
| **Sep 4** | **Labour Day** | All provinces & territories | First Monday in September. |
| **Oct 9** | **Thanksgiving** | All provinces & territories | Second Monday in October. |

### Quick Summary

- **Family Day** – Feb 20 (most provinces, except Toronto)
- **Victoria Day** – May 22 (nationwide)
- **Canada Day (observed)** – Jul 3 (nationwide)
- **Civic Holiday** – Aug 7 (most provinces)
- **Labour Day** – Sep 4 (nationwide)
- **Thanksgiving** – Oct 9 (nationwide)

> **Note:**  
> - New Year’s Day (Jan 1) is observed on Monday, Jan 2, but it does **not** create a long weekend because it’s a Monday only.  
> - Christmas Day (Dec 25) is also a Monday only, so it’s not a long weekend.  
> - Some provinces have additional holidays (e.g., St. Patrick’s Day in Newfoundland & Labrador, St. George’s Day in Prince Edward Island) that may create long weekends if they fall on a Monday or Friday, but those are not part of the federal holiday schedule.

Feel free to plug this table into your holiday‑planning app! If you need province‑specific details beyond the ones listed above, let me know.
